overview: The Green Bay Police Department (GBPD) is using Flock Automatic License Plate Readers (ALPRs) to help detect and reduce crime in our community. Flock ALPRs are stationary ALPR cameras located within Municipal - Right of Ways and are self-sufficient. They are powered by solar panels and send image information through government-standard encrypted cell signals. The ALPRs capture objective evidence without compromising individual privacy. The GBPD utilizes retroactive searches to solve crimes after they have occurred. These cameras are not used for traffic enforcement. Additionally, GBPD utilizes real-time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals and missing endangered children and adults. To ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, the GBPD has our policies and usage statistics available to the public here on the GBPD website at www.gbpolice.org under Inside GBPD.
